description:
3D portable speaker across beach and party scenes, highlighting youth-driven enjoyment, powerful features, and an AI actor–led closing dialogue.

This video showcases a portable speaker through a dynamic ad film that moves from beach parties to night-time hangouts, capturing how the product fits seamlessly into modern, music-driven lifestyles, all without a physical shoot.

You’ll see a precise 3D speaker model in action, with features like deep bass, waterproof build, and powerful sound visualized through immersive CGI. All youngsters shown using the product are virtually created, interacting naturally in each scene. The film concludes with an AI actor delivering a confident, brand-style dialogue that brings the product story together.

Every environment, character, sound-driven animation, and product visual is produced using AI, CGI, and VFX, on our high-end GPU systems, allowing brands to create entertainment-led speaker ad films without studios, crews, or live filming.
